arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import json

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)
# From column 35 - Net excise taxes
monthly_data = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

print("Monthly Net Excise Taxes (millions of dollars):")
months = ['Oct 2017', 'Nov 2017', 'Dec 2017', 'Jan 2018', 'Feb 2018', 'Mar 2018', 
          'Apr 2018', 'May 2018', 'June 2018', 'July 2018', 'Aug 2018', 'Sept 2018']
for m, v in zip(months, monthly_data):
    print(f"  {m}: {v}")

# Calculate Mean
mean = sum(monthly_data) / len(monthly_data)
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate Absolute Deviations
abs_deviations = [abs(x - mean) for x in monthly_data]
print("\nAbsolute Deviations:")
for m, ad in zip(months, abs_deviations):
    print(f"  {m}: {ad}")

# Calculate Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD)
mad = sum(abs_deviations) / len(abs_deviations)
print(f"\nMean Absolute Deviation (MAD): {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
EOF
